messages.snippet: Sarah, We'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on a new bolt-on acquisition. Target is Greaves Precis
messages.subject: Project Falcon - new acquisition mandate
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on a new bolt-on acquisition. Target is Greaves Precision Components, a precision-machining business in Rochdale. Founder-owned, four sellers, headline EV around £28m. We've signed nothing yet beyond initial conversations.

Can you and the team take this on? We'd like to move quickly - aiming to complete in early October if diligence is clean.

Mark

Mark Ferris
Head of M&A, Bracken Group plc

messages.snippet: Mark, Delighted - we'd be glad to act. I'll lead, with James Osei (senior associate) running the day
messages.subject: RE: Project Falcon - new acquisition mandate
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark,

Delighted - we'd be glad to act. I'll lead, with James Osei (senior associate) running the day-to-day and Tom Gallagher supporting on diligence. Our standard engagement terms will follow from Donna shortly; the matter reference is WC-00116.

As first steps I suggest: (1) a mutual NDA before any information changes hands; (2) heads of terms once you've settled the headline economics with the sellers; and (3) we open a data room and issue our due diligence request list. Happy to jump on a call tomorrow.

Kind regards
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate / M&A
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
